Work that sits alongside the dissertation: analyses, datasets, and tools that are
useful on their own.

## Saudi fisheries statistics analysis

Analysis of national fisheries and aquaculture statistics, aimed at describing
production trends and their implications for marine resource management and the
Blue Economy.

*Status: in progress. Add outputs, figures, and any resulting manuscript here.*

## Crayfish distribution and contact zones

Spatial analysis of *Faxonius neglectus* and *Pacifastacus leniusculus* occurrence
records to identify where the two ranges meet.

*Status: feeds Chapter 3. Add maps and code links here.*

## Reproducible analysis workflows

R and Quarto pipelines that take raw field data through models, figures, and tables
to a rendered document, so an analysis can be rerun end to end.

*Status: ongoing. Link public repositories here.*

## Interactive research framework

A browser-based framework illustrating the bass–crayfish interaction system
studied in this dissertation.

[View the framework](https://behes2024.github.io/bass-crayfish-framework/)
